name: MAXIS
recent: Maxis 公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，并宣布第三次中期股息每股 4.5 仙。属关联方交易。EPF 在 8 月至 11 月间多次申报持股变动。
notable: 宣布第三次中期股息每股 4.5 仙，除息日 2026 年 11 月 27 日，派发日 2026 年 12 月 22 日。
根据 2023 年长期激励计划（LTIP）发行 67,200 股新股，上市日 2026 年 11 月 25 日。
risks: 内部审计总监 Faizul bin Abdullah 于 2026 年 8 月 26 日出售 28,000 股普通股。
EPF 在 2026 年 8 月至 11 月间多次申报持股变动。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度营收为 26.71 亿令吉，环比增长 1.1%，同比增长 3.7%；净利为 4.47 亿令吉，环比增长 2.5%，同比增长 8.5%；净利率为 16.7%，高于上一季度的 16.5%。

recent_en: Maxis reported its 3Q FY2026 results and declared a third interim dividend of 4.5 sen per share. It also proposed to acquire broadband business assets from Astro's MBNS for up to RM83 million, a related party transaction. EPF filed multiple changes in shareholding between August and November.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of broadband business assets from MBNS, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Astro, for up to RM83 million, a related party transaction.
Declared a third interim dividend of 4.5 sen per share, ex-date 27 November 2026, payment date 22 December 2026.
Issued 67,200 new shares under the 2023 Long Term Incentive Plan (LTIP), listing date 25 November 2026.
risks_en: Director of Internal Assurance Faizul bin Abdullah disposed of 28,000 ordinary shares on 26 August 2026.
EPF filed multiple changes in shareholding between August and November 2026.
earnings_en: 3Q FY2026 revenue was RM2,671 million, up 1.1% QoQ and 3.7% YoY; net income was RM447 million, up 2.5% QoQ and 8.5% YoY; net margin was 16.7%, up from 16.5% in the previous quarter.
